added.title: Collider and direct detection as key probes of asymmetric dark matter: Signals from a compressed Inert Higgs doublet
added.reason: Materially contextualizes the LZ high-energy recoil as an inelastic compressed inert-doublet signal and develops correlated collider and direct-detection tests.

added.title: A Comprehensive Interpretation of the LZ High-Energy Recoil Event: A Minimal $U(1)_B$ Dark Sector and Its Experimental Tests
added.reason: Directly interprets the 248 keV candidate through endothermic up-scattering in a gauged-baryon-number model and quantifies complementary tests.

added.title: Modular $S_4$ Inverse Seesaw at the LZ High-Recoil Frontier
added.reason: Directly models the candidate as endothermic scattering of a singlet pseudo-Dirac state in a modular inverse-seesaw construction.

added.title: Probing LZ-Motivated TeV Higgsino Dark Matter through Heavier Sparticles at LHC
added.reason: Directly tests the LZ-motivated TeV Higgsino interpretation through present and projected LHC searches for heavier sparticles.

added.title: Signature of GW from the Hidden Sector in light of the Recent LZ Event
added.reason: Directly explains the recoil with endothermic pseudo-Dirac dark matter and links the signal region to a hidden-sector gravitational-wave signature.

judgmentCalls: 2610.14178v1 was included as adjacent electroweak work because its central compressed inert-doublet analysis materially contextualizes the inelastic LZ interpretation, even though the paper studies a broader asymmetric-dark-matter model.

2610.14188v1, 2610.15557v1, and 2610.18234v1 were placed only in Other endothermic DM because each recoil comes from up-scattering of a non-electroweak singlet state; their gauge, flavor, and gravitational-wave settings remain secondary metadata.

2610.16156v1 was placed only in Electroweak inelastic DM as a collider constraint on the LZ-motivated TeV Higgsino scenario; the heavier sparticles are test channels rather than a new recoil category.
The additions received semantic coordinates near related mechanisms and contiguous layout ranks 126-130; all established coordinates and ranks remain unchanged.
The pre-existing 2609.06640v2 human-review item remains unchanged; its public catalog record and citation edges stay pinned to v1 pending editorial review.
